title: PDF Q&A — Prototype Demo & Technology Deep Dive

scenes.text: Two instruction manuals. One thousand six hundred and twenty-three scanned pages. And not a single searchable character. Finding one safety rule could take an evening. This is the problem PDF Q and A was built to kill.
scenes.hi: Scanned PDFs tasveerein hain, text nahi. Do engine manuals, 1,623 pages, aur ek bhi searchable akshar nahi. Ek safety rule dhoondhne mein raat ho jati thi. PDF Q and A yahi problem khatam karta hai.

scenes.title: One screen: upload, database, AI chain, chat
scenes.text: This is PDF Q and A. Drop in any PDF, even a thousand-page scanned manual, and it reads every page, saves everything into a database, and answers your questions with the exact page number. No cloud. No subscription. It runs on your own machine.
scenes.hi: Ye hai PDF Q and A. Koi bhi PDF daalo, chahe 1,000 page ka scanned manual ho, wo har page padhta hai, sab kuch database mein save karta hai, aur jawab deta hai exact page number ke saath. No cloud, no subscription. Tumhare apne machine pe chalta hai.

scenes.title: Scanned pages are read locally, live
bullets: drag and drop, up to 20 files, 1 GB each
RapidOCR on ONNX Runtime, on this machine
scenes.text: Uploading is drag and drop, up to twenty files at once. Scanned pages are read locally by Rapid OCR, and you watch every page land in the database live: page number, percentage, time remaining. Nothing leaves your computer.
scenes.hi: Upload karna hai drag and drop, ek saath 20 files tak. Scanned pages Rapid OCR khud padhta hai, aur tum dekhte raho har page database mein jaata hai: page number, percent, time remaining. Kuch bhi tumhare computer se bahar nahi jaata.

scenes.title: Every answer carries its source
bullets: built from the top database passages
file name, page number, match score
open Sources to read the exact passage
scenes.text: Now ask. The answer comes back with its source: the file name, the page number, and a match score. Open the sources and you are looking at the exact passage the database found. You can verify everything yourself.
scenes.hi: Ab poocho. Jawab aata hai apne source ke saath: file ka naam, page number, aur match score. Sources kholo aur tum dekh rahe ho wohi passage jo database ne dhoondha. Sab khud verify kar sakte ho.

scenes.text: Here is the pipeline. The browser talks to an Express server. A Python worker extracts text with PyMuPDF; scanned pages go through Rapid OCR. Prisma writes every page and chunk into SQLite, with an FTS5 full-text index. A question runs a BM25 search first, then builds the answer from the top passages.
scenes.hi: Ye raha pipeline. Browser baat karta hai Express server se. Python worker text nikalta hai PyMuPDF se; scanned pages jaati hain Rapid OCR mein. Prisma har page aur chunk likhta hai SQLite mein, FTS5 full-text index ke saath. Sawaal pehle BM25 search chalata hai, phir jawab banta hai top passages se.

scenes.text: Then the AI chain. Ollama runs first, entirely on your own machine. Then GLM, NVIDIA NIM, OpenRouter, and Gemini. If one provider fails, the next one answers. And if every provider fails, you still get the database answer. The system never stops.
scenes.hi: Phir AI chain. Ollama pehle, bilkul tumhare apne machine pe. Phir GLM, NVIDIA NIM, OpenRouter, aur Gemini. Ek provider fail hua to agla jawab deta hai. Aur sab fail ho gaye to bhi database ka jawab milta hai. System kabhi rukta nahi.

scenes.text: Libraries and models, exactly as shipped. Node twenty and Express. Prisma seven with the libSQL driver. SQLite with an FTS5 index and BM25 ranking. PyMuPDF for text and layout. Rapid OCR on ONNX Runtime. Ollama runs Qwen two point five, seven B, locally. The cloud chain is GLM four point seven Flash, NVIDIA Nemotron three point five Lightning, OpenRouter, and Gemini Flash Lite.
scenes.hi: Libraries aur models, bilkul jo ship hua hai. Node 20 aur Express. Prisma 7, libSQL driver ke saath. SQLite, FTS5 index aur BM25 ranking ke saath. Text aur layout ke liye PyMuPDF. Rapid OCR, ONNX Runtime pe. Ollama chalata hai Qwen 2.5 7B locally. Cloud chain: GLM 4.7 Flash, NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, OpenRouter, aur Gemini Flash Lite.

scenes.title: View, export, delete — and it works on a phone
bullets: the same app at 390 pixels wide
scenes.text: Your data stays yours. View any page, export to text, CSV or JSON, delete with a confirmation. The whole app works on a phone. And a complete Docker plus EC2 deployment guide ships in the repository.
scenes.hi: Tumhara data tumhara rehta hai. Koi bhi page dekho, export karo TXT, CSV ya JSON mein, delete karo confirmation ke saath. Poora app chalta hai phone pe. Aur repository mein milti hai poori Docker plus EC2 deployment guide.

scenes.text: Setup is one command. Run one command. Then drop a PDF and ask. The full guide, the Word documents and the code are in the repository. Thanks for watching.
scenes.hi: Setup ek command hai. Run ek command hai. Phir PDF daalo aur poocho. Poori guide, Word documents aur code, sab repository mein hai. Dhanyavaad!
